newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysian blue chips surge 1.7 percent in rebound.
newsitem.headline: Malaysian blue chips surge 1.7 percent in rebound.

text.p: Malaysian blue chips continued to recoup ground on Thursday, gaining nearly 1.7 percent near midday.
Dealers had expected a firmer sentiment in Kuala Lumpur shares after the Dow chalked up three days of recovery. But some remained skeptical the gains would hold in Malaysia.

"Who's to say this won't flush out more selling," said Jonathan Duckett, institutional dealer at Mohaiyani Research, referring to the Composite Index's rise. At 0357 GMT, the blue chip index rose 1.68 percent or 18.26 points to 1,106.04. It hit a session high of 1,108.62 earlier.
